milestones.label: Applications open for the 2027 TaiwanICDF scholarship
milestones.source_text: TaiwanICDF's own Apply Now page (official) gives the 2027 application window as 1 December 2026 to 15 March 2027. The funder's guidebook says all training is conducted in English.

milestones.label: Application deadline, 2027 TaiwanICDF scholarship
milestones.source_text: Closing date of the same official window (1 December 2026 to 15 March 2027); applicants must also meet each partner university's own deadline.
